title: services: starvation, ranking, end_round + STARVATION_CHECK / ROUND_END handlers
criteria:
1) realm/services/ranking.py: `get_ranking(s, world_id, cfg) -> list[RankingRow]` (RankingRow from realm.services.views): one row per player of the world; villages = number of the player's villages; population = sum over ALL building rows of the player's villages of cfg pop_per_level*level (use economy.population on (type, level) pairs; load buildings with ONE joined query, no per-village queries); sorted by population desc, then villages desc, then player id asc; rank = 1-based position.
2) realm/services/villages.py: APPEND `handle_starvation(s, village_id, now, cfg) -> None` (do not modify existing functions). Missing village -> return silently. Steps: lock the village, villages.settle_village(now), (rates, capacity) = compute_rates; starving only when village.food <= 1e-6 AND rates.food < 0; if not starving -> after_change(...) and return. Otherwise kill troops whose home_village_id == village.id: candidates = Troop rows ordered with troops located AT HOME (location == village) first, then troops located elsewhere; inside each group by cfg.units[unit].upkeep descending (ties: unit key, then row id). deficit = -rates.food (food per hour already scaled by world speed); per killed unit the rate improves by upkeep*world.speed; for each candidate row kill k = min(row.count, ceil(remaining_deficit / (upkeep*speed))) units (stop as soon as the deficit is <= 0), decrement/delete rows. Units inside moving Movement rows are never killed (they keep counting for upkeep). If anything was killed: reports.create_report(s, owner_player_id, 'info', 'ทหารอดอาหารตาย', {'village_id': id, 'name': village.name, 'killed': {unit: n}}, now) and notify.notify(s, world_id, [owner], 'village', village.id). Afterwards recompute the rates: if the food rate is now >= 0 call after_change; if it is STILL negative (nothing left to kill) do NOT call after_change (that would reschedule an endless chain of checks at `now`): just cancel the village's pending STARVATION_CHECK events (events.cancel_pending) and leave the food at 0.
3) realm/services/worlds.py: APPEND `end_round(s, world_id, now, cfg) -> None` (do not modify existing functions): world = s.get(World, world_id); None or status != 'running' -> return (idempotent); rows = ranking.get_ranking(s, world_id, cfg); winner = rows[0] (when the world has players); set world.status = 'ended', world.winner_player_id = winner.player_id; create one 'info' report for EVERY player of the world (bots too) with title f'จบรอบเกม ผู้ชนะคือ {winner.name}' and data {'winner': {'player_id','name','population','villages'}, 'top': first 10 ranking rows as dicts, 'your_rank': that player's rank}; notify all players of the world with kind 'round_end'.
4) realm/engine/handlers.py: STARVATION_CHECK handler `handle_starvation_check` calls villages.handle_starvation(s, ev.payload['village_id'], ev.due_at, cfg); ROUND_END handler `handle_round_end` calls worlds.end_round(s, ev.world_id, ev.due_at, cfg); other handlers unchanged.
Tests (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world via worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=2, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0); village A = the human's village; fresh village economics at speed 1: food production 12/h (6 farms x 2), population 2 so food rate +10/h):
- starvation order: A.food = 0, Troop(home=A, location=A, 'heavy_cavalry', 10) and Troop(home=A, location=A, 'spearman', 20): rate = 12 - 2 - (10*3 + 20*1) = -40. handle_starvation(now t0): kills ceil(40/3) -> capped at 10 heavy_cavalry (rate -10), then ceil(10/1) = 10 spearmen (rate 0) -> remaining Troop rows: spearman 10 only; killed == {'heavy_cavalry': 10, 'spearman': 10} in the 'info' report titled 'ทหารอดอาหารตาย'; compute_rates food rate afterwards == 0.0; no endless chain: at most the check created by after_change (none when rate >= 0).
- at home before away: A.food = 0, Troop(home=A, location=A, 'spearman', 20) and Troop(home=A, location=B (a bot village), 'heavy_cavalry', 5): rate = 12 - 2 - (20 + 15) = -25: kills all 20 spearmen first (rate -5), then ceil(5/3) = 2 heavy_cavalry away (rate +1): rows left: heavy_cavalry away 3.
- moving units are never killed: only a Movement row (from A, status 'moving', units {'heavy_cavalry': 10}) and A.food 0: rate = 12 - 2 - 30 = -20; handle_starvation kills nothing, creates no report, food stays 0, and there is NO pending STARVATION_CHECK for A afterwards (assert count 0).
- not starving: A.food = 100, troops giving rate -40: nothing dies; after_change leaves exactly one pending STARVATION_CHECK due at now + 100/40*3600 = now + 9000 s.
- speed: in a speed 10 world (second test world) the same troops need deficit scaled by 10 (food rate = 10*(12) - 10*(2 + upkeep)); verify with hand numbers: Troop(home=A,location=A,'spearman', 30) -> rate = 120 - (2+30)*10 = -200 -> kills ceil(200/(1*10)) = 20 spearmen leaving 10 (rate 120 - (2+10)*10 = 0).
- engine integration: schedule a STARVATION_CHECK event for the starving village and run realm.engine.worker.process_next(s, world, t0, cfg): troops die and the event ends 'done'; a STARVATION_CHECK for a deleted/unknown village id ends 'done' (no failure).
- ranking: set bot1's town_hall level to 3 (pop 6), others fresh (pop 2): get_ranking order [bot1, human, bot2] (tie 2 vs 2 broken by player id: the human was created before the bots); ranks 1..3; villages 1 each; population values 6, 2, 2; a player with an extra village counts villages 2 and the sum of both villages' population.
- end_round: after end_round(s, world.id, t0 + 60 days, cfg): world.status == 'ended', winner_player_id == bot1.player id, one 'info' report per player (3) whose data winner name equals bot1's name and your_rank matches; calling end_round again creates no extra reports; the ROUND_END event processed through the engine (process_next with now >= ends_at) ends the world; after that services.worlds.current_world raises NOT_FOUND and the API-level WORLD_ENDED guard is unaffected.
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY these exact strings (copy letter by letter; proofread): 'ทหารอดอาหารตาย' and the f-string 'จบรอบเกม ผู้ชนะคือ {winner.name}'. Do not type other Thai.
- Existing test tests/engine/test_worker.py::test_noop_handlers schedules STARVATION_CHECK for village_id 1 which may not exist: handle_starvation must therefore return silently for a missing village.
- Lock rule: only one village is locked here. Never commit, never call datetime.now().
- Imports in villages.py: reports and notify are services modules; avoid circular imports (reports.py imports only models/views/errors, so `from realm.services import reports` is safe; ranking.py must import nothing from worlds/villages).
- Python math.ceil for the kill counts; deficits are floats, guard against tiny float noise (treat deficit <= 1e-9 as done).
- If the existing tests/engine tests need an assertion change because a stub now has real behaviour, tests/engine/test_worker.py may be edited minimally (it is NOT in the write list: instead make the new handlers tolerate the old test's inputs).
